facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Guaranteed Capital: Yes after secondary selection into full accelerator; follow-on conditional
facts_raw.Funding / Support: US$40K funding for teams selected into the full accelerator; 10 startups receive an additional US$100K at the annual showcase
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Stage 1: selected into pre-accelerator bootcamp; Stage 2: strongest teams selected into full accelerator receive $40K; Stage 3: 10 showcase winners receive additional $100K
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Funding described as program funding/grant; no equity take published on current official FAQ
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No rigid incorporation requirement published; startup/team with evidence of progress required
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Global applicants welcome; international startups need a clear, realistic and obtainable plan to expand to Saudi Arabia within one year of program start
facts_raw.Can Apply Pre-Idea: No / evidence of startup progress required
facts_raw.Can Apply Solo: No — at least two founders required
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: At least two founders; evidence of startup progress (customer interviews, signed client interest, or other validation); full program commitment; at least one team member must attend all required accelerator activities; no simultaneous accelerator unless TAQADAM approves an exception; IP users must have written commercialization permission from university/company TTO.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: Strong complementary team, scalable business model, customer-focused founders, evidence of market validation, clear Saudi expansion strategy for international startups.
facts_raw.On-site Required: Yes / hybrid with mandatory in-person events
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Six-month commitment. Official FAQ describes a bootcamp plus required in-person week/events at KAUST; most ongoing sessions are virtual/monthly. Attendance is mandatory for required activities.
facts_raw.Visa Support Level: Visa + flight support for required in-person program functions
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: No full-time relocation requirement published, but international startups must plan Saudi expansion within one year and attend required KAUST events. Program supports visas/flights for required in-person activities.
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Cohort 7 application deadline was extended to Jun 5, 2026; next cohort not yet published
facts_raw.Application Materials: Startup/team application covering team, scalability, market potential, progress/validation, Saudi expansion plan where relevant; later committee review and bootcamp selection.
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Official site / register-interest form / public admissions email
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: good for startups willing to build a real Saudi market-entry path. $40K is not paid just for initial bootcamp acceptance; it follows the second-stage selection into the full accelerator. The extra $100K is competitive follow-on funding for 10 showcase startups.
